hero.release: Downloads and Harbor in the Windows dashboard
hero.description: Capture, upload and share from a native Windows app, browse your files in File Explorer, and search them with AI that runs on your own server. Open source and self-hosted.
hero.dashboardAlt: The Fileship dashboard home page with recent uploads and storage charts
hero.mobileAlt: Fileship files page on a phone

features.title: More than a place to drop screenshots.
features.description: Files, nested folders, notes, short links and inboxes, with the apps around them to make it feel like a real cloud. On your hardware, under your rules.

windows.label: Fileship for Windows
windows.title: Capture, annotate, record. The link is on your clipboard.
windows.description: A native tray app, ShareX style. Pick a region across every monitor, draw on it before you let go, copy text with OCR or record a video or GIF. It idles at a few megabytes.

harbor.title: Your files in File Explorer.
harbor.description: Online-only until you open them. Rename, move or delete in Explorer and it syncs.
harbor.name: Name

ai.label: AI on your server
ai.title: Find a photo by describing it.
ai.description: Smart search in over 50 languages, captions, OCR and sensitive content detection. Every model runs on your machine, and all of it is optional.

sharing.label: Sharing on your terms
sharing.title: Passwords, expiry and view limits on every link.
sharing.description: Share folders with other users as viewers or editors, and design how your links look in Discord.

storage.title: Store it anywhere
storage.description: Local disk, any S3 compatible service, SFTP or FTP. Move everything to a new storage in one step.

updates.title: Updates without downtime
updates.description: One click or on a schedule. The new version starts next to the old one and takes over once it is healthy.

users.title: Built for more than one
users.description: Users with permissions and storage limits, invites, passkeys, two-factor authentication and single sign-on with OpenID Connect.

toolbox.title: And the rest of the toolbox
toolbox.notesText: Write and share notes, public or private.
toolbox.linksText: Short links with click counts, passwords and limits.
toolbox.inboxesText: A page where anyone can send you files, no account needed.
toolbox.trashText: Deleted files wait in the trash before they are gone.
toolbox.backupsText: Daily or weekly account backups you can restore.
toolbox.webhooksText: Discord, Slack or signed JSON on uploads, links and notes.
toolbox.phoneText: An installable app that Android apps can share to.
toolbox.duplicatesText: Spot identical files before and after you upload them.
toolbox.languagesText: From English and Türkçe to 日本語 and 简体中文.

compare.title: How Fileship compares
compare.description: Against Zipline 4.8, XBackBone 3.8 and Chibisafe 6.7, checked in October 2026. Coming from one of them? {link}
compare.migrate: Bring your accounts, files and links over.

rows.desktop: Desktop app for capture and recording

getStarted.title: Running in a minute.
getStarted.description: All you need is Docker with Compose, 2 CPU cores and 2 GB of RAM (4 GB or more with AI). Then open {address} and log in.

footer.tagline: Open-source, self-hosted file and media management. MIT licensed.

docs.description: Install Fileship on your own server, put it behind a web server, configure it and connect your apps and uploaders.
